key_evidence_spans: A man in his 40s with a medical history of factor VII deficiency hemophilia presented with acute hypoxic respiratory failure
He was also found to have Staphylococcus hemolyticus bacteremia
Three days after admission, the patient developed erythema and edematous necrotic plaques of the bilateral ears
Erythematous plaque (2 cm) with overlying eschar on the right earlobe
biopsy findings: Detached epidermis with full-thickness necrosis overlying sparse inflammation associated with necrosis of adnexal epithelia
necrosis progressed during the following days
